description: Power quality analyser: voltages, currents, powers, power factors, frequency, THD, unbalance, mean, min and max values with timestamps, energies by tariff and settings
source: Janitza, UMG 509-PRO Modbus address and formulary, 06/2024, Dok. Nr. 1.059.004.2.n
notes: Addresses are those of the address list, as sent. Read with function 03 (or 04), write with 06 or 16.
Values are big-endian as listed; the device also serves little-endian copies at address + 32768.
Measured values in float or integer format include the transformer ratios; short-format values do not.
Not in this map: the per-harmonic arrays (_FFT_*: values, means, maxima and their times for every harmonic), which the address list gives as several thousand registers.
Written from the manufacturer's address list; not tested on a device.
